verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents SOC 2 framework controls mapped into its Unified Controls (SOC 2-to-Unified Control map, framework controls view). Policies can be created, approved, published and acknowledged in the platform, and evidence requests are tracked inside audits that run 'from scoping through final report' in one platform. missing for 10: no explicit evidence of separate Type I vs Type II audit workflows, no explicit mention of the Trust Services Criteria or a pre-built set of required SOC 2 policy templates, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
